facts: In 2003, Dr. Roger Mugford invented the "wagometer," a device that claims to interpret a dog’s exact mood by measuring the wag of its tail.
A bloodhound named Tigger holds the record for the longest ears, each measuring more than 13 inches.
Dogs are direct descendants of wolves.
When dogs copulate, it is very normal for them to get stuck together and it may last for up to 45 minutes.
A dog's nose is made up of about 220 million scent receptors, while a human's nose has about 5 million.
